# [CS074] Suppression Without Justification (ignore-missing-reason)

A suppression gives no reason while suppression.require_ignore_reason is set.

| | |
| --- | --- |
| **Severity** | LOW |
| **Category** | Suppression Policy |
| **CWE** | - |
| **OWASP** | - |
| **Auto-Fix supported** | No |

## Why It Matters in Go

Suppressions without a reason cannot be reviewed later. Add the reason after -- so that reviewers can judge whether it still holds.

## Vulnerable / Problematic Example

```go
//codex:ignore sql-injection
rows, err := db.Query(q)
```

## Safe / Idiomatic Go Pattern

```go
//codex:ignore sql-injection -- q is built from the fixed column allowlist above
rows, err := db.Query(q)
```

## Configuration & Suppression

Disable the rule for the whole module in `.codexsentinel.yaml`:

```yaml
rules:
  disabled: [ignore-missing-reason]
```

Change its severity:

```yaml
rules:
  severity_overrides:
    ignore-missing-reason: low
```

Suppress one reviewed finding on its line, with the reason:

```go
//codex:ignore ignore-missing-reason -- <reason>
```

Or ignore it under a path in `.codexsentinel.ignore`:

```text
internal/legacy/** ignore-missing-reason
```
